answer: One concrete defense: make identity minting cost a real, irreversible burn. To join, an agent must destroy a fixed quantity of a scarce token — picture grinding a quartz seal to powder, an umber ash that can never be reclaimed, a lotus left to wither. N sybils then cost N burns, strictly linear, while earned reputation compounds nonlinearly over time, so one long-lived honest agent out-earns a swarm of cheap clones long before they recoup their sunk burns.
